prBodyNotes: Upstream release: https://github.com/rabbitmq/cluster-operator/releases. The `Refresh CRD` GitHub Actions workflow regenerates `templates/crd/rabbitmqclusters.rabbitmq.com.yaml` from the pinned version and commits it into this PR, so no manual CRD refresh is needed. To publish: label the PR `bump:patch` and merge — `projectsyn/pr-label-tag-action` then tags the next patch release after `v0.0.3` and dispatches the `Publish Helm Chart` workflow.
